crane_rail_h_m.how: top of rail where the far crane's end trucks sit, photo 007: fronto-parallel two-depth metrology (Criminisi et al. 2000) — the crane's own rail span (GOST 534-78: 24 m - 2*lambda = 22.0-23.0 m) gives its depth (69 m), the floor at the far end wall is the reference, the horizon cancels; Monte Carlo over focal, camera place/height, wall position, rail span and +-6 px reading: median 8.08, 5-95 % 7.81-8.36. Agrees with the 2026-09-27 perspective estimate (runway top 8.2 m) and with the Soviet unified crane-rail level 8.15 m for 24 m spans; the VGGT cloud's 6.6-7.4 is rejected (VGGT compresses telephoto/far depth). Scale check in the same photo: the end wall's steel double door reads 2.01 x 2.39 m (a standard 2.0 x 2.4 m industrial door).
crane_rail_h_m.source: photo 007-file_90.JPG (owner, private) via scripts/place/crane_height.py on rigs/moxir-crane-picks-2026-09-29.json

crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.how: underside of the bridge girders at mid-span, photo 007 (edge profile at x 1750/2250): 7.96 m, 5-95 % 7.69-8.24; 0.12 m (0.05-0.20) BELOW the rail head — the box girders hang between the end trucks and are shallower at their ends (end underside rail +0.27). Measured on the FAR crane; the entry-end crane (the one to park over the DJ) is ASSUMED the same type: same runway, same yellow double-girder bridge with the same slotted side plates (photos 004/010/012/032 from under it); its own underside is not measured.
crane_bridge_bottom_h_m.source: photo 007-file_90.JPG (owner, private) via scripts/place/crane_height.py on rigs/moxir-crane-picks-2026-09-29.json
